Under this task, NREL and Eaton will support the Universal Interoperability for Grid-forming Inverter (UNIFI) consortium. This work will include hosting working groups on aspects of grid forming inverters modeling, controls, interoperability and developing specifications for grid forming inverters. The deliverable of this task will be a draft of specifications for grid-forming inverters. Estimated completion: 18 months from project start. The purpose of this task was to support the Universal Interoperability for Grid-forming Inverter (UNIFI) consortium in developing a draft document of specifications for grid-forming inverters. This task planned and hosted working groups of national laboratory scientists, industry members, and academics to provide input on specifications. The draft specifications document was assembled and passed among the working groups for editing. A final draft was publicly posted on the UNIFI website with an open request for comments and feedback. Summary EPRI J1 feeder was selected for the distribution system analysis.
